title: Bender Problem
statementMd:
Robot Bender decided to make Fray a birthday present. He drove $*n*$ nails and numbered them from $1$ to $*n*$ in some order. Bender decided to make a picture using metal rods. The picture is a closed polyline, which vertices should be nails (in the given order). The segments of the polyline should be parallel to the coordinate axes. Polyline is allowed to have self-intersections. Bender can take a rod and fold it exactly once in any place to form an angle of 90 degrees. Then he can attach the place of the fold to some unoccupied nail and attach two ends of this rod to adjacent nails. A nail is considered unoccupied if there is no rod attached to it (neither by it's end nor the by the fold place). No rod could be used twice. It is not required to use all the rods.

Help Bender to solve this difficult task.

## Input

The first line contains two positive integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($4 ≤ *n* ≤ 500, 2 ≤ *m* ≤ 500$, $*n*$ is even) — the amount of nails and the amount of rods. $*i*$-th of the following $*n*$ lines contains a pair of integers, denoting the coordinates of the $*i*$-th nail. Nails should be connected in the same order as they are given in the input. The last line contains $*m*$ integers — the lenghts of the rods. All coordinates do not exceed $10^{4}$ by absolute value. Lengths of the rods are between $1$ and $200 000$. No rod can be used twice. It is guaranteed that all segments of the given polyline are parallel to coordinate axes. No three consecutive nails lie on the same line.

## Output

If it is impossible to solve Bender's problem, output `NO`. Otherwise, output `YES` in the first line, and in the second line output $*n*$ numbers — $*i*$-th of them should be the number of rod, which fold place is attached to the $*i*$-th nail, or `-1`, if there is no such rod.

If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
机器人 Bender 决定为 Fray 制作一份生日礼物。他钉入了 $*n*$ 枚钉子，并以某种顺序将它们编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。Bender 决定使用金属杆制作一幅图案。该图案是一条闭合折线，其顶点应当是这些钉子（按照给定顺序）。折线的各条线段应当与坐标轴平行。折线允许自相交。

Bender 可以拿起一根金属杆，在任意位置将其恰好弯折一次，形成一个 $90$ 度角。随后，他可以将弯折处固定在某个未被占用的钉子上，并将这根杆的两个端点固定在相邻的钉子上。如果某个钉子上没有固定任何金属杆（无论是通过杆的端点还是弯折处），则称该钉子未被占用。一根金属杆不能被使用两次。不要求使用全部金属杆。

请帮助 Bender 完成这项艰巨的任务。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个正整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$4 ≤ *n* ≤ 500$, $2 ≤ *m* ≤ 500$，$*n*$ 为偶数），分别表示钉子和金属杆的数量。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数，表示第 $*i*$ 枚钉子的坐标。钉子必须按照输入中的顺序连接。最后一行包含 $*m*$ 个整数，表示各根金属杆的长度。所有坐标的绝对值均不超过 $10^{4}$。金属杆的长度介于 $1$ 和 $200 000$ 之间。每根金属杆最多只能使用一次。保证给定折线的所有线段都与坐标轴平行。不存在连续三枚钉子位于同一直线上。

## 输出格式

如果无法解决 Bender 的问题，输出 `NO`。否则，第一行输出 `YES`，第二行输出 $*n*$ 个数，其中第 $*i*$ 个数应为弯折处固定在第 $*i*$ 枚钉子上的金属杆编号；如果没有这样的金属杆，则输出 `-1`。

如果存在多种解，输出任意一种即可。
